description.value:
Some battles are won not by striking hardest, but by refusing to fall. Those sentinels who follow the Path of Tenacity plant themselves between danger and the ones who need protecting, drawing the Force into a shield that turns aside blade and blaster bolt alike.

Steadfast and unyielding, these sentinels bend the tide of a fight through sheer endurance, absorbing punishment meant for their allies and answering every strike against them with a swift, practiced riposte.
